risk: Open-weight model training data cannot be verified; outputs could resemble copyrighted works and expose users and BeatMind to claims
mitigation: Prefer models with a published data statement (ADR-007); similarity screening before delivery; takedown process; disclose risk in terms and to investors; move to licensed data after funding
trigger_to_watch: A rights-holder claim or a court ruling against the model publisher

risk: Google Lyria 3 already supports Hindi and reaches Indian users through Gemini and YouTube
mitigation: Compete on price; ownership; downloads; creator workflow and regional languages; do not compete on raw quality
trigger_to_watch: Google consumer pricing or YouTube integration in India

risk: Open models do not reach acceptable quality in Hindi and regional languages
mitigation: Language quality gate G1 before beta; Lyria 3 API fallback for failing languages; publish only passing languages

risk: No free production GPU capacity; inference cost before funding
mitigation: Smallest viable model; scale-to-zero GPU workers; credit programmes; invite-only beta with daily caps

risk: January 2027 target is not achievable for a stable public launch
mitigation: Treat January 2027 as demo and closed beta (A-003); cut scope to the MVP list
trigger_to_watch: Sprint velocity in first two sprints

risk: Voice cloning or artist imitation misuse
mitigation: No voice cloning in Phase 1; block artist names in prompts; impersonation reporting

risk: Watermark or provenance stripped; failure to meet India IT Rules and EU Article 50 marking duties
mitigation: C2PA manifest plus inaudible watermark plus server-side ledger; label in UI and metadata; test robustness
trigger_to_watch: Regulator guidance or failed robustness test

risk: Free-tier abuse (bulk generation; spam uploads to streaming services)
mitigation: Daily generation caps; device and payment fingerprinting; attribution on free songs; per-account limits

risk: Single points of failure on free-tier hosting cause outages
mitigation: Stateless services; managed Postgres with backups; queue-based workers; status page; documented migration path to paid cloud

risk: Three-person team is overloaded; key-person dependency
mitigation: Narrow MVP; automation; documentation; shared ownership of components

risk: Rights promise to users conflicts with model licences or law (purely AI output may not be copyrightable)
mitigation: Promise transfer of whatever rights BeatMind holds; never promise copyright protection; counsel review

risk: Russian-language demand cannot be monetised inside Russia because of sanctions and payment restrictions
mitigation: Support Russian language for users outside Russia; no paid launch in Russia

risk: Low willingness to pay in India keeps revenue per user low
mitigation: Purchasing-power price bands; annual plans; UPI; creator-focused value; international English users at higher bands

risk: Personal data obligations under India DPDP Act and Rules phase in during 2026-2027
mitigation: Privacy by design; consent records; retention limits; breach process; DPIA in Batch 2

risk: Competitors sign label licences and set licensed training as the market norm; unlicensed models lose distributor acceptance
mitigation: Track distributor policies; prepare licensed-data plan for post-funding
